statements.t: “Following the completion of enrollment in X-NOVA2, we are working toward our first Phase 3 data readout in psychiatry with topline results now expected in December 2026.
The Company expects multiple new azetukalner and epilepsy data presentations at the American Epilepsy Society (AES) 2026 Annual Meeting, taking place December 4-8, 2026, in Denver, Colorado.
The Company expects to initiate X-FIRST, a new Phase 3b/4 study, which is designed to evaluate azetukalner as a first adjunctive antiseizure medication (ASM) in patients with FS.

we may not achieve additional milestones in our proprietary or partnered programs
regulatory agencies may delay the initiation or completion of clinical studies or impose additional requirements prior to approval
the impact of market, industry, and regulatory conditions on clinical study enrollment
the impact of expanded product development and clinical activities on operating expenses
